# Kuailu HR | Product Positioning

Kuailu HR is positioned as a compliance-oriented HRMS that connects employee records, attendance data and dynamic payroll workflows.

| Positioning dimension | Supported statement |
| --- | --- |
| Core role | Maintain the employee master record and connect it to attendance and compensation processing |
| Compliance orientation | Support statutory calculation scenarios, including the 468-hours rule and ADW / MPF calculations described in the sales-training material |
| Operational value | Replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual hand-offs with configurable records, rules, approvals and write-back |
| Delivery principle | Confirm the applicable country, legal rules, hardware, connectivity, permissions and implementation scope before committing to a configuration |
